create_session_recorder: create a SessionRecorder to track HITL sessions with config, connection records, and episode indices
start_episode: call start_episode on SessionRecorder to begin recording a new episode with metadata
record_frame: call record_frame on SessionRecorder to log frame data for the current active episode
end_episode: call end_episode on SessionRecorder to finalize an episode with completion status and metrics
get_episode_outputs: call get_episode_outputs on SessionRecorder to retrieve all recorded episode data as EpisodeOutput objects
